# Calculator City

> > Calculator City provides free specialized calculators for military travel (PCS/TDY), financial planning, technical calculations, and comprehensive guides for Texas Instruments, Casio, Sharp, and HP calculator usage.

The site serves both practical calculation needs (military reimbursement, loan amortization, electrical engineering) and educational purposes with interactive tutorials covering PEMDAS/BODMAS order of operations, memory functions, and graphing calculator simulators for TI-84 and TI-83 models.

## Key Topics

- PCS (Permanent Change of Station)
- TDY (Temporary Duty)
- JTR (Joint Travel Regulations)
- DTOD (Defense Table of Official Distances)
- TI-84 Plus / TI-84 Plus CE
- PEMDAS / BODMAS order of operations
- Texas Instruments calculators
- Casio scientific calculators
- Percentage calculations
- Loan amortization
- Calculator memory functions (MS/MR/M+/M-)
- IEEE 754 floating-point
- NEC electrical standards
- Interactive calculator simulators

## Military & Travel Calculators

- [Army Travel Day Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/army-travel-day-calculator): Calculate PCS/TDY travel days, MALT reimbursement per JTR standards
- [Partial PPM Move Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/partial-ppm-move-calculator): Estimate military PPM/DITY move reimbursement and profit for PCS
- [Is The Commute Worth It Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/is-the-commute-worth-it-calculator): Calculate true commute cost including opportunity cost and expenses
- [Transit Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/transit-calculator): Compare public transit vs driving costs, time, and CO2 emissions

## Calculator Tutorials & Guides

- [How Do I Use Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/how-do-i-use-calculator): Complete step-by-step guide covering basic to scientific calculations
- [How To Use On Calculator Percentage](https://cal2.calculator.city/how-to-use-on-calculator-percentage): Interactive percentage calculator with formulas and use cases
- [How To Work Out Percentage Using Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/how-to-work-out-percentage-using-calculator): Comprehensive percentage calculation tool with step-by-step examples
- [How To Use Your Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/how-to-use-your-calculator): Interactive guide for basic calculator operations and best practices
- [How To Use In On Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/how-to-use-in-on-calculator): Master calculator usage with PEMDAS/BODMAS order of operations guide
- [Learn How To Use A Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/learn-how-to-use-a-calculator): Interactive simulator teaching basic arithmetic and memory functions
- [How To Use Store And Recall On A Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/how-to-use-store-and-recall-on-a-calculator): Master MS/MR/M+/M- memory functions with interactive simulator

## Graphing Calculator Simulators

- [How To Use TI-84 Graphing Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/how-to-use-ti-84-graphing-calculator): TI-84 simulator for graphing functions and window settings tutorial
- [Graphing Calculator TI-83 How To Use](https://cal2.calculator.city/graphing-calculator-ti-83-how-to-use): TI-83 online simulator for quadratic graphing and window settings
- [How To Put X On A Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/how-to-put-x-on-a-calculator): Solve linear/quadratic equations for X on TI-84 and Casio calculators

## Financial & Professional Calculators

- [Free Online Calculator Use Loan Amortization](https://cal2.calculator.city/free-online-calculator-use-loan-amortization): Free loan amortization calculator with payment schedule and extra payments
- [Calculator With Steps](https://cal2.calculator.city/calculator-with-steps): Arithmetic sequence solver with step-by-step formula breakdowns
- [10-key Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/10-key-calculator): Professional accounting adding machine with digital audit tape
- [SPAXX Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/spaxx-calculator): Calculate Fidelity SPAXX money market dividends and after-tax yield

## Specialized & Technical Calculators

- [Transformer Primary Fuse Size Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/transformer-primary-fuse-size-calculator): Calculate transformer fuse sizing per NEC 450.3 standards
- [Siege Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/siege-calculator): Estimate siege breach times, attrition rates for warfare planning
- [Inside A Calculator](https://cal2.calculator.city/inside-a-calculator): Visualize IEEE 754 floating-point binary representation and precision
